name: arena-quiz-platform
description: Real-Time Quiz & Polling Arena (Kahoot Clone) with React Bits Aesthetics

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "magenta.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
